inference.hint: Look for the operational requirement: response time, request volume, device location, hosted access, or change between training and production.

inference-01.label: Returns a prediction immediately for an interactive request where low latency matters.
inference-01.why: Returns a prediction immediately for an interactive request where low latency matters.

inference-02.label: Processes many stored records together when an immediate response is unnecessary.
inference-02.why: Processes many stored records together when an immediate response is unnecessary.

inference-03.label: Runs the model near the data source or device to reduce latency, bandwidth use, or connectivity dependence.
inference-03.why: Runs the model near the data source or device to reduce latency, bandwidth use, or connectivity dependence.

inference-04.label: A hosted interface through which applications send inputs and receive model outputs.
inference-04.why: A hosted interface through which applications send inputs and receive model outputs.

inference-05.label: The time between submitting an inference request and receiving its result.
inference-05.why: The time between submitting an inference request and receiving its result.

inference-06.label: The number of inference requests or records processed in a period of time.
inference-06.why: The number of inference requests or records processed in a period of time.

inference-07.label: The distribution of production inputs changes from the data used during training.
inference-07.why: The distribution of production inputs changes from the data used during training.

inference-08.label: The relationship between inputs and the correct output changes over time.
inference-08.why: The relationship between inputs and the correct output changes over time.
